annotations.title: Create prepaid account with a Gambot number (no API key, card required)

description: Create a new PREPAID organization with NO Gambot API key (public self-serve) - the way to BUY A NUMBER/SIM from Gambot. There is NO trial: the card is verified, the number (simInfo.purchaseInTwilio=true + simInfo.selectedSimNumber from gambot_search_available_numbers) is bought, and the FIRST period (plan + SIM) is charged immediately. If the charge fails nothing is created and the number is released. Buying a number requires a VERIFIED verificationId: first run gambot_send_onboarding_verification then gambot_verify_onboarding_code and pass it here. Prices are fixed by Gambot (the plan/payEach/currency you send only select the tier); never promise a trial or a free SIM. companyInfo.companyName + companyInfo.companyIdNumber (ח.פ/ת.ז) are required; send companyInfo.timezone and companyInfo.country. Returns wabaConnectUrl (open in a browser to connect WhatsApp) and statusUrl - then poll gambot_get_onboarding_status.

attribution.description: OPTIONAL analytics: how the user found Gambot, e.g. { source, referrer, landing_page, utm_source }. Only what is actually known - never invent.

card.description: REQUIRED. { cardNumber, expirationDate ("MM/YY" or "MM/YYYY"), cvv?, holderId? }.

companyInfo.description: { organizationName (required), timezone (IANA, recommended; derived from country if omitted), country (ISO-3166 alpha-2), companyName, idNumber, companyUrl, companyPhoneNumber }.

verificationId.description: REQUIRED when buying a number (simInfo.purchaseInTwilio=true): a verificationId that passed gambot_verify_onboarding_code.
